headline: SUNSHINE SILVER HITS 1,000+ g/t Ag IN IDAHO — New '10 Vein' Opens Fresh System; Feasibility 2027, Production 2028 (NYSE: SSMR)
snippet: Sunshine Silver Mining & Refining (NYSE: SSMR) reported July 23 results from its 50,000-metre program at the historic Sunshine Mine in Idaho's Silver Valley — returning multiple intercepts exceeding 1,000 g/t silver across several vein systems, including a newly identified '10 Vein' that expands the mine's near-surface high-grade footprint. The program is 60% complete with three active underground drill rigs and remains on track for October 2026 completion, providing the technical dataset for a planned 2027 Feasibility Study ahead of targeted first silver production in late 2028 — one of the few permitted, high-grade U.S. silver projects with a credible development timeline.

headline: FITZROY MINERALS: 111.9m AT 0.97% Cu FROM SURFACE — 4 Rigs, 22,000m Expanded Program at Buen Retiro Chile (TSXV: FTZ)
snippet: Fitzroy Minerals Inc. (TSXV: FTZ) reported July 23 that drill hole BRT-DDH072 at the Buen Retiro Copper Project in Copiapó, Chile returned 111.9 metres at 0.97% Cu from 21.1 metres — including 18.0 metres at 1.59% Cu — in leachable material close to surface along the 1.7-km Tenorita trend. With 78 holes and 13,036 metres drilled since February 2026 and four rigs active, Fitzroy expanded the program to 22,000 metres, building the continuity dataset for what management characterizes as a potential near-term Chilean copper heap-leach operation as copper prices approach a new U.S. record.

headline: LITHIUM SINKS TO 5-MONTH LOW AT $20,210/T — MinRes Bald Hill + CATL Restarts Stoke 2027 Glut Fears
snippet: Lithium carbonate on the Guangzhou Futures Exchange fell to 136,800 yuan ($20,210/tonne) — its lowest level since February 2026 — as investors priced in a wave of restarted mine capacity threatening to tip the market into oversupply in 2027. Mineral Resources restarted its wholly owned Bald Hill mine in Western Australia (165,000 tpa spodumene capacity) and CATL brought the Jianxiawo project back online in late June, adding approximately 3% of global output back to a market that had priced in its absence; global lithium production is projected to grow 26% year-on-year in 2026, with traders reporting limited restocking appetite despite continued strong EV and energy storage demand.

headline: SILVER X MINING: 735 g/t Ag OVER 65m — Drill Program Expanded 5-FOLD to 6,650m at Peru's Red Silver (TSXV: AGX)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Silver X Mining
snippet: Silver X Mining Corp. (TSXV: AGX) announced July 22 it is expanding its Red Silver Project drill program more than five-fold to 6,650 metres — from an initial 1,200 metres — following underground channel sampling at the María Luz sector of the Nueva Recuperada Project in Huancavelica, Peru that returned 735 g/t Ag over 65 metres and 649 g/t Ag over 40 metres of strike. Diamond drilling is now underway to test the continuity of high-grade vein systems at depth, with the goal of growing the existing Mineral Resource and upgrading Inferred ounces on one of Peru's most prospective high-grade silver systems.

headline: AMERICAS GOLD & SILVER Q2: 665K oz Ag, GALENA FIRE DENTS OUTPUT — $85M DEBT CUT; H2 Recovery Expected (TSX: USA)
snippet: Americas Gold and Silver Corporation (TSX: USA / NYSE American: USAS) produced 664,971 ounces of silver in Q2 2026 — 15% below Q1 after an electrical fire at the Galena Mine briefly interrupted operations and deferred a planned high-grade stope into Q3. The company simultaneously cut US$85 million in debt obligations and maintained full-year guidance of 3.2 to 3.6 million ounces at AISC of US$30–$35/oz, projecting a stronger H2 as the deferred Galena stope comes accessible; with silver above $58/oz, margin expansion potential is significant if the company hits the top end of guidance.

headline: BRIXTON METALS: 5,015 g/t Ag OVER 20m — Shaft 6 SE Brownfields Discovery at Cobalt Ontario's Historic Camp (TSX-V: BBB)
snippet: Brixton Metals Corporation (TSX-V: BBB) drilled 5,015 g/t silver over 20 metres in the new Shaft 6 Southeast area at its wholly owned Langis Silver Project in Cobalt, Ontario — Canada's most historically prolific silver district. The result comes from Brixton's largest campaign to date: 24,017 metres completed across 105 holes in 2026, targeting both infill and expansion of established high-grade zones. At current silver prices above $58/oz, a 5,015 g/t intercept over 20 metres represents exceptional in-situ value density in a system being systematically defined ahead of a resource update.

headline: GOLDSEEK JULY 22: WORLD CUP METALS RALLY STALLS — Gold-Silver Trapped Between Bulls and Bears; $4,000 Floor Critical
snippet: GoldSeek's July 22 Asian metals market update notes that gold and silver rallied during the soccer World Cup period but now face renewed macro headwinds as markets digest the approaching July 28–29 FOMC decision and Iran-driven oil inflation. The analysis examines precious metals caught between structural long-term bulls — central bank demand running at record pace, silver's sixth consecutive supply deficit, and a bank consensus year-end gold target range of $4,800–$6,300 — and short-term intraday bears keeping the metals under pressure as Brent's surge above $100 raises the probability of a September Fed rate hike.
